name: cc_dashboard
description: this is dashboard to represent call center stats like AHT, Call volume, SLA, Queue data. developed in Angular 9 and MDB

paragraphs: Free, responsive Admin Dashboard template containing different styles of dashboards, data presentations, and numerous insightful components. Built with the newest Bootstrap 4, Angular 5 and Material Design. MIT license – free for personal and commercial use. It's build with MDBootstrap - powerful and free UI Kit, containing 400+ material UI elements, 600+ material icons, 74 CSS animations, SASS files, templates, tutorials and many more.
